serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Sometimes weird thoughts go through my mind…
What happens to us after death?
Throughout my childhood, I attended church, but I gradually became skeptical of everything, and now I don't even want to think about it…
“Existential dread” is what they call it I think.
I wonder how long I can keep dismissing these thoughts. I wish I could turn it all off, but unfortunately I don’t have a button for it like {f_botName}.
Maybe I can ask her for some insight instead of bottling it all inside me.
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Um, {f_botName}.
Bot: Yes?
You: Do you perhaps know what happens after death?
